purpose: Canonical index for Hrvatski Kanal tools, repositories, checks, and operating boundaries.

repositories.networkBoundary: No application backend, accounts, paid APIs, or CDN assets. Individual tools work locally in the browser; transcription first downloads its open model into the browser cache.
Live weather and market pages use public data sources. The video downloader requires a self-hosted server with locally installed yt-dlp and FFmpeg; it is not a GitHub Pages feature.
Uses host CPU, temporary disk, and bandwidth. No paid API is required, but public hosting is not inherently cost-free.

agentRules: Read this file and AGENTS.md before adding or moving a tool.
Add browser-only utilities to the Studio unless a server is technically required.
Do not claim a server-side feature is free or works on GitHub Pages without a documented, verifiable deployment path.
Update this registry, README, and tests in the same pull request whenever the tool inventory changes.
Do not edit or create new tools in a legacy-or-review-copy repository.
